# openmetadata_database_schema Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata database schema by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_database_schema" "public" {
  fully_qualified_name = "local_postgres.sales.public"
}

output "public_schema_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_database_schema.public.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Database schema fully qualified name, in the form database.schema. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Database schema UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `database` (String) Fully qualified name of the database that owns the schema.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Database schema name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
